title: スコープ変更の判断
when: Decide whether to add, cut or change scope or requirements of planned work

steps.title: 変更の価値と依頼元を確認
steps.desc: Clarify the value of the change and who requested it

steps.title: 開発チームに工数見積りを依頼
steps.desc: Ask the team for an effort estimate

steps.title: 代わりに外す項目を検討
steps.desc: Identify what would be dropped or delayed to make room
steps.check: Is the current plan or sprint already full or at risk?

steps.title: 採否を決めてバックログに反映
依頼元へ結果を回答
steps.desc: Reply to the requester with the decision
